name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
how_to:
1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed slightly outward.
2. Hold a dumbbell vertically with both hands, letting it hang between your legs.
3. Engage your core and keep your chest upright as you bend your knees and lower your hips.
4. Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
5. Push through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
